title.zh: ICE Is Running One of the Largest Anti-Left Surveillance Ops in US History
title.en: ICE Is Running One of the Largest Anti-Left Surveillance Ops in US History

current_state.zh: A Wired investigation details how Homeland Security Investigations combined infiltrated Signal chats with commercial data-broker records, cloud host Fly.io's DNS and SSH session logs, and Stripe payment fingerprints to identify a developer who built a license-plate search tool, describing it as one of the largest anti-left surveillance operations in US history.
